description: Optional pattern timeline: Timeline renders ordered steps (an upgrade plan, a setup checklist) as an <ol> on a vertical connector line, each with a number or icon marker, a status badge (icon and text), a title, an optional description, optional chips (package 1.2.0 → 1.3.0) that fold behind a Show N more Collapsible, and an optional count; default and compact density. lib/timeline.ts folds the chips.
